name: West Sussex: Chichester – Amberley
description: The West Coastway from Chichester through Barnham and Ford, over the River Arun to Arundel Junction, then up the Arun Valley line through Arundel to Amberley. Branches to Bognor Regis and Littlehampton.
attribution: Track, stations, crossings and scenery © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL). Terrain: Mapzen/Tilezen terrain tiles (SRTM, EU-DEM). Signals, gradients and timetables are generated: see docs/ASSUMPTIONS.md.
